Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno and molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054502' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
